body.p: An old man is ill. A hare is shamanizing him. The hare said: "Let me go for the people [hares], they will repeat singing". There the old man said: "Old woman, let's eat the hare! Let me shamanize [= betray] it. Don't tell anything, lock the door well, let me be ill, bring me a metal sword". He started shamanizing. The hare said: "It is covered with clouds". [DCh]: The analysis of "horontilda" is very tentative.The hare was beaten by the old man. When that one was beating, the old woman started watching. The old was beating only with the metal, the hare's ear became black. Then the old woman killed one with her tooth(?). Those [hare's] teeth became as big as the those of [nowadays'] hares]. The ears of hares are black until now. The hare couldn't go on the cloud, it began to sit the whole day on the earth. On a cloudy day it is also sitting like that. On a cloudless day it is eating willows.
